beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please stop stirring the wedding cake batter with the whisk handle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It still moves the batter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So does a shoe. We use the loops.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shoe wouldn't bend like this whisk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put both feet down. I'll finish the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm the electrician. Please stop testing the socket with a spoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's wooden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An encouraging first decision. Now step away.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should I get a metal spoon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. You've graduated to holding the torch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely auction. I've raised my paddle for the traditional warm-up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just bought the wardrobe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: For eight thousand pounds?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. The usual amount of storage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you removed your socks?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Management potential. Always one step ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a beautiful painting. You're still using the brush grip I showed you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You showed me finger painting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The foundation of every hand movement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paint with my feet now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. You've taken my principles beyond the syllabus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only the caretaker. Plan whatever concert you like.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll start at eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I unlock the hall at nine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we have a key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Submit your preferred concert time to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't put me on the committee. I just send the invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We voted to invite everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Which six people shall receive them?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone means everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put that on next week's agenda. I send those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations, Mayor Pudding Pants. Where's the buffet?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please don't use that nickname at my inauguration.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Mayor Pudding. We can be formal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are reporters here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Finally, someone to verify the custard incident.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice corner office. Still hiding biscuits in your socks?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the director now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you can afford a drawer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we discuss the contract?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After you empty your left sock. I can hear it crunching.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you accept your award, remember who drove you to the audition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already thanked you in the speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said 'transport.' I have a name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll thank you personally next time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Next time? Good. I'll need a seat beside the award.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your bakery looks wonderful. Where's my founder's discount?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You lent me a mixing bowl.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before there was cake, there was my bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've returned it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't return the beginning of a dream.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed your lunch and labelled your umbrella. Again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can pack my own lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you a checklist so you can.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't need to make a checklist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. I'll add 'appreciate checklist' myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've cleaned the kitchen while you slept. You're welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was going to clean it at nine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And leave me knowing it was dirty until nine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Next time, wake me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Now I'm responsible for your alarm too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded twelve towels. How many have you done?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not racing. I'm washing them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Different event. Convenient choice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can win towel folding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not by concession. Fold one properly and make it count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your tomato's impressive. Mine weighs two grams more.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're making a salad.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's keep the winning tomato separate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already chopped it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. We'll compete by number of pieces.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can you check my resignation letter? Just the spelling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spelling's fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And resigning? Does that word suit me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ask your manager.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you ask? I'd trust the answer more in your voice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're coming to the dentist with me, aren't you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The dentist knows what to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I need you to confirm that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not a dentist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. You have no professional reason to defend the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put out the blue cups. So we're doing this again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're the only clean ones.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how it started last time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wash the red cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't call that a fresh start.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Interesting choice of song for our first road trip since the incident.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the traffic report.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And they're mentioning that roundabout very casually.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can take another road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said before we needed another car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your pie crust is gorgeous. I've copied the lattice with smaller gaps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't need to improve it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Improve? I'm celebrating you more precisely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would you like my recipe?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. I'll return it with respectful corrections.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You make public speaking look effortless. I practised your shrug all night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just be yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. My version of your shrug has more range.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There isn't a competition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That sounds so confident. I'm using that too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put 'Lightning' on my retirement cake. That's what the band called me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake says Graham.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Graham worked in accounts. Lightning had a smoke machine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a small family party.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then get a small smoke machine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I still wear my motorcycle jacket to the school run.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've arrived on a folding bicycle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same wind. Same man.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've got a basket full of lunchboxes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Touring equipment. Don't touch the skull sticker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why does the new receptionist have a key? I open this office.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could take a day off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And let the door forget me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a spare key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll keep it safe. Spares are my department too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've bought an electric mixer. My birthday cakes weren't enough?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It'll save you time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Time for what? Being replaced by the toaster?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You still choose the recipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The mixer reports to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ordered you the mild curry. You're welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wanted the hot one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's exactly the impulse I'm protecting you from.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've told the waiter not to believe you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I booked your quiet holiday instead of the climbing trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I love climbing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You love surviving it. I've kept that part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cancel the booking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No refunds. Sometimes caring requires a deposit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What do you think of my blue shirt? Purely academic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I prefer the green one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So do I. This is my changing shirt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wear whatever makes you happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you sound happier about the blue?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've named my boat Independence. Your opinion obviously doesn't matter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a bit long.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Indie, then. That was always the nickname.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I liked Independence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The paint's still wet. Nothing's been decided by you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Careful with that shelf. I built it. From wood.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding the books nicely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All forty-seven. You can count them if you're impressed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would you like a compliment?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, no. Just look at it from the difficult angle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've left my marathon medal beside the kettle. Accidentally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's blocking the tea bags.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A difficult obstacle. Much like mile twenty-three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Congratulations on the marathon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, you noticed? I haven't shown you the split times.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we eat, the biscuit must complete three clockwise turns.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already in my mouth.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then turn your chair. Slowly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I swallow first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not until the biscuit faces home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please stand for the opening of the office fridge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only want my yoghurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We acknowledge the light before approaching the shelf.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bulb's broken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today we open it in remembrance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's a drop of water beside the kettle. We need an evacuation route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spilled it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We've identified the source. Stop producing water.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've wiped it up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Where's the cloth? The threat has changed location.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That chair squeaked. Don't put any more weight on the building.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It needs oil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're proposing a flammable solution during a structural emergency?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stand up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slowly. We don't know what's holding you down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The power's out! Our candle collection finally gets its premiere.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't own candles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A shopping trip with a purpose!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shops have no power either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. The whole town's joining in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our flight's cancelled. We've been given a bonus airport day.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hotel won't refund us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then our room will stay beautifully clean.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We won't be in it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our most restful holiday yet. Even the bed gets a break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If the ceiling's talking, does it need a microphone for the meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not surprised the ceiling talks?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm concerned the people under the balcony won't hear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only speaks in prophecy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Can it predict the parking bill?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your dragon can stay in the flat. Which meter measures its heating?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It breathes fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it pays the gas bill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It insists on being called Your Majesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put that on the standing order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody moves out until I find the paperclip from my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The removal van is charging by the hour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make the driver help look.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The landlord wants the keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He can have the building. I want the paperclip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You changed 'regards' to 'best regards' in my email.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also got us the contract.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can discuss that after removing 'best.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's worth a million pounds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they should respect my regards as they were.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two red buses and now your red scarf. We're being directed somewhere.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wear this every day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they've been preparing you for years.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My phone's ringing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Answer it. The timetable's getting impatient.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift stopped on three. There are three of us. This is arranged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are four of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One of us is the messenger.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's stopping on four now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Message received. We stay together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ordered everyone's sandwiches. We saved six minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm vegetarian.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've already removed your ham. Seven minutes saved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I choose next time?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You could, but I've ordered next time too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Chairs face the window. I've moved them while you were deciding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The speaker's at the other end.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then moving the speaker is quicker than moving twelve chairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already speaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll rotate the room during the applause.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm covering reception until two. Deliveries now use the side door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've always used the front.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And we must be decisive during this transition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The receptionist will be back in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then knock twice. We haven't time to print the new signs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: While the teacher's out, I'm monitoring silence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked you to hold her keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A quiet responsibility. Stop jingling your pencil.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's coming back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I need to brief her on our progress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Those towels need folding with the seams inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody sees them in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I do. That's why I'm qualified to stack them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I close the cupboard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After you level the third towel. Doors don't correct technique.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All the mug handles must face four o'clock.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're going in the dishwasher.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A professional loading angle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spray comes from below.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it deserves a properly presented underside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've moved my usual table at this café.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've only opened today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, much fresher since my last visit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What would you like?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My usual. Let's see whether you've changed that too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Where's the hook I always use at this club?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the cleaner's cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've reorganised again. Typical.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have you been here before?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before all these changes, obviously.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me demonstrate how to tie that parcel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already tied it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Untie it. Learning begins with observation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's going to be opened anyway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay for my lesson on receiving a parcel.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you make tea, watch my wrist with the kettle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made tea for twenty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll appreciate the advanced pour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've finished the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now make one under supervision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Happy to open the supply cupboard. Which project is this for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We just need batteries.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll need to know which drawer to authorise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll buy some.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I have the petty-cash key too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got the room-booking list. When do you want your meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The room's empty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I know why.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we use it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As soon as I've decided whether it should stay empty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your chipped mug, my ugly mug. I'll wash; you dry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought a dishwasher.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You can hold the towels while it learns.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It dries them too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you can supervise your replacement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've knocked twice on your window. Ready for our usual walk?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I moved the doorbell so you wouldn't need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I'll ring it twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you text first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll text two knocks. You'll know it's me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home. That makes three lifts and a borrowed umbrella.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought you coffee yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which covers the first roundabout.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said the lift was no trouble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct. Trouble is charged separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you water my plants? I covered your shift in March.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was one afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And these are only six small plants.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One is a tree.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shift included overtime.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've reminded you about the dentist tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in my calendar.
