beats.text: How do we do that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Light the acknowledgement candle. We're nearly at the beginning of finishing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've tied the ceremonial knot. Now bless the successful tying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought the knot finished it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That was the opening knot's ambition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many knots remain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One for asking, then we can count formally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's a missing letter in this notice. Reality's losing components.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a typo.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Today a letter. Tomorrow the word floor stops holding us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll correct it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use permanent ink. We need structural reinforcement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said that sentence twice. Time's slipping.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you didn't hear me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the disturbance's reached my ears.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I repeat it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. We'll prop the wall up before risking a third loop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The kettle's floating! Tea no longer needs a table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's escaping upstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct delivery. A second breakthrough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't reach it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally, a reason to use the ladder indoors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The guest came through the wall. Wonderful, no queue at the door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a hole in the plaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A permanent improvement to hospitality.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What about the rain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An outdoor feeling without leaving the sofa.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, a dragon in the kitchen. Dry food or wet?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It eats treasure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do supermarkets sell that in bulk?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It also breathes fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Heating savings may cover the food bill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The invisible guest can stay. Who takes the first feeding shift?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's immortal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then weekend cover matters indefinitely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't know if it eats.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Label the leftovers. We'll establish a baseline.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that pebble level. It's the only thing holding Tuesday here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's an ordinary pebble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly why Tuesday trusts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I put it down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On a level surface. Wednesday's waiting for a mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't press the third button on the kettle. That's the moon's dimmer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do we make tea?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the first two. Tea and lunar stability are separate jobs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The third one's flashing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the moon wants attention. Don't reward it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three coffee rings, three visitors. The universe is composing a message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all ordered coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And all chose circles. Remarkable discipline.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The door squeaked three times.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There. The message has acquired a chorus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said wait as the scales showed my weight. Hear the rhyme?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's just coincidence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you said just beside the justice poster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not until the universe finishes its sentence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we discuss the kitchen fire, may I approve last week's minutes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The minutes are in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must establish whether anyone remembers them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember voting to replace the extinguisher.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can begin with matters arising.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wedding speeches go father, mother, best man, bride.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bride needs to say the groom hasn't arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That information belongs in her speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't start without him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then his absence is holding up four perfectly prepared speakers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As acting manager, I'm authorising everyone to stay late.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who appointed you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That question needs to be submitted on company stationery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You printed this stationery this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I've already established a proper channel for challenging it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm chairing this meeting under the emergency neighbourhood charter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are only two of us, and I haven't agreed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll record your objection before proceeding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Proceeding to what?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A vote to recognise my authority to record objections.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your evacuation plan uses the wrong shade of red.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It got everyone safely outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Without compliant arrows, that's technically a gathering.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The building was on fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the arrows should have been particularly unambiguous.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This cake cannot pass inspection. You've written 'Birthday Happy.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The icing slid. Does it taste all right?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Taste is in section four. We're still on greeting accuracy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we turn the plate around?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That corrects the order while introducing an upside-down birthday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't sit in that chair at the family dinner. That's where absent people go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's absent?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll find out when someone complains you're in their chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stand, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Standing means you're leaving. Let me introduce you as undecided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At this club, 'interesting proposal' means they want you to withdraw it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair called my proposal very interesting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then withdraw it enthusiastically. They value a good attitude.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What would genuine enthusiasm sound like?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An invitation to lunch. This is why newcomers need a translator.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring a sandwich to the permit office. I lost three Tuesdays learning that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says appointments take ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how they get your first Tuesday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked the first slot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So did I. Eat half the sandwich before they open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't ask the committee why the roof leaks. Ask which meeting owns the leak.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I asked why. They made me chair of causes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you fix it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. But I can keep you out of causes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your moving van is ready. It just needs my departure stamp.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wonderful. Could you stamp it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Have you completed the departure-stamp request?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're holding that too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I like to keep the process convenient for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club has approved your opening ceremony. I'm holding the ribbon scissors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then cut the ribbon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Once I receive confirmation that the ceremony has begun.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cutting it begins the ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I'll wait for the confirmation beside the ribbon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before dinner, we still split the first bread roll. Like when we shared a room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can afford two rolls now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll each have half of two.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's mathematically a whole roll.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, but you can't buy the sharing separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You haven't given me our old knock before coming in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You gave me a key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The key opens the door. The knock tells me it's you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can see me through the glass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And yet I haven't heard from my best friend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I got your late application accepted. You can take my shift on Saturday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was two years ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exceptions don't expire like ordinary favours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It took you one phone call.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then Saturday should be a refreshing change of pace for us both.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Since I waived your joining fee, I'd like you to nominate me for treasurer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you back the fee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You repaid money. I made you an exception.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's the exchange rate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Currently, one enthusiastic nomination.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Optional attendance' means arrive early and look surprised to be needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only asking where the toilets are.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Facilities. Never say toilets here. I'll walk you through it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Through using the toilet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Through asking. Using it remains largely unregulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When Dad says 'don't bring anything,' he means bring bread but conceal the receipt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He texted me a shopping list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what we call an unusually clear emotional opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. He's meeting us halfway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I got our permits in six minutes. What took you so long?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine took five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you use the expedited counter?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used the website.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I helped design that counter's redundancy strategy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You bowed twice at the awards dinner. The handbook specifies one bow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The host bowed back, so I returned it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you accidentally acknowledged them as senior.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They are the host.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I congratulated them without conceding rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you introduce me to the committee? Just not as your promising little discovery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How should I introduce you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As an independent professional whose work speaks for itself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you can introduce yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It speaks more clearly after you've said my name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please get me into the club, but don't tell them you rescued me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm just signing your application.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A signature, not a creation story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It asks how I know you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the period after 'colleague' decisively.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're changing the birthday rota? Apparently turns matter again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We just need someone for Friday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I needed someone last Friday. You said the rota was sacred.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put 'sacred unless away' at the top this time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're letting guests use the good mugs now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only because the other mugs are packed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I used one, you called it a breach of trust.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then explain why they're guests and I'm still a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How did you get into the members' lounge without showing your pass?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They know me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll learn every doorman's birthday. Systematically.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can introduce you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, thank you. I'd like to develop spontaneous rapport properly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You knew which fork to use without looking. I've studied the whole table plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I copied the person beside me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could have copied. I chose independent mastery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're serving soup now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me a moment to revise my fork research.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The complaint desk is here to listen. That's what my old badge says.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no one at the desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Listening takes many forms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sign says it's closed permanently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then perhaps they're giving our concerns a very long silence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club always looks after its own. I've paid dues for thirty years.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've rented your locker to someone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There must be a respectful explanation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The new member paid more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ah. They've updated the meaning of 'its own.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On this picnic form, does 'bringing food' include bringing the plates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just tick whatever seems closest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is there a box confirming that you authorised approximation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a picnic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why have they left the sandwich category so open?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: May I ask a question during the induction?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Questions are encouraged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Should I register mine first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No. Just ask.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is asking permission counted against the question allowance?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've written a checklist so you can safely make tea while I'm out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made tea for forty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You can initial the experience section.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just have water?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cold or room temperature? I need the correct appendix.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you borrow my bicycle, let's rehearse what to do if you wobble.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put my foot down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Which foot?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever side I'm falling toward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I hadn't included improvisation. We'll need another rehearsal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have I bowed deeply enough to join the choir, or is that the rehearsal bow?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't bow until the concert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll keep this one in reserve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can stand up now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I didn't want to be the first person to abandon tradition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I memorised the club toast, including the footnotes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't any footnotes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I researched the founding members' preferred pauses.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually just say 'cheers.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Would that be the formal or familiar cheers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Notice the green stamp on your permit. Very few people know why it's green.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thanks for getting it approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approval is easy. The colour history is fascinating.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I start building?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After you appreciate why it isn't blue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I used the proper salutation on your complaint letter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wonderful. They fixed the leak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But did they mention the salutation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They sent a plumber.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll ask him whether he noticed the regional variation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set an empty bowl for Great-Uncle Arthur before we serve dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Arthur is here this year.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then he'll finally get to see his bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we put soup in it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not after forty years of keeping it empty for him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We must walk around the new boat three times before launching it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who started that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My grandfather.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did he explain why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He completed all three circuits. That was explanation enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The visitor book is missing your middle initial. Stop the tour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll add it now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need a witness for amendments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're watching me write.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And who will confirm I was watching correctly?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You skipped item six on the kettle checklist.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Item six says check that the lid is closed. It's closed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But we can't prove you checked it before item seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll start again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First we need a procedure for interrupted kettle procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've been in this queue two hours. Imagine how thoroughly they're checking things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The counter is empty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. No rushed decisions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The office closed an hour ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're protected from after-hours processing too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My application has gone to a third committee. Such a reassuring system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The first two lost it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And yet a third committee stands ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want you to apply again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. This time three committees know what to look for.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If the moon audits our village tonight, who signs for the findings?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The oldest owl.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is the owl available before the post office closes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only works after dark.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'd better budget for a late filing fee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the dragon's naming ceremony, where do we put the fire extinguishers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The dragon eats anyone who brings one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Who handles the insurance exemption?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody insures dragons.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the deposit needs to cover the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This marriage certificate has the dot above the wrong letter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've been married twenty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Socially, certainly. Typographically, it's complicated.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have three children.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's correct it before they inherit the error.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You placed the club seal upside down. This isn't a valid resignation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already moved abroad.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Travel doesn't rotate a seal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can turn the page over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That makes it an internationally submitted resignation. Different form.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sat beside me at lunch. Shall I record that as our friendship policy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was the only empty chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So friendship is allocated by availability. Useful clarification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow I'll save you a seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We've moved from allocation to a reserved entitlement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You apologised before making tea. Is that our conflict-resolution procedure now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I knocked over your cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So material damage triggers refreshments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also felt bad.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll add remorse as an optional supporting document.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I won the bake-off, so next year's theme is cakes I already make.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't fair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fairness needs experienced leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You won by half a point.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll chair the half-point committee too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As winner of family bowling, I choose where we eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only agreed you'd get a trophy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A trophy recognises judgement under pressure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Choosing dinner wasn't part of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely why the winner must now define the next event.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That lost chess game was practice. This rematch will establish my reputation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've played here for thirty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then thirty years deserves a decisive demonstration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just came for tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Best tea wins. Give me five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ignore my terrible karaoke score. The next song determines whether I still have it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody doubted you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. One flawless song will keep it that way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The machine's been unplugged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we finally have a chance to judge the voice itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't claim longest scarf until we've measured without stretching it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's obviously longer than yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a visual impression. Put it on the calibrated table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You knitted the table cover.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which is why I know how much it stretches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cake got nine out of ten for taste. What's the denominator for presentation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone loved it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Love isn't scored consistently between judges.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've eaten the evidence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'most thoroughly consumed' is the only category I can certify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you ask who invited me to the committee, I've balanced its accounts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You still need a membership vote.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've counted the votes too. You're short a treasurer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not how joining works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll draft a joining process that doesn't lose money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've repaired the stage lights. Is there room for me in the theatre group now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just come to a rehearsal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll learn everyone's lines first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to audition for the audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll start with being your best audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely winning serve. My drills finally paid off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've never trained with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You watched me practise. Observation is powerful teaching.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I copied the person who beat you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my defeat provided the lesson. You're welcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You negotiated a brilliant discount. That's my influence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You told me to pay full price.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I was provoking independent judgement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So your wrong advice taught me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Advanced coaching looks deceptively unhelpful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on winning the raffle. Before I open the prize box, a few conditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought the winning ticket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. The ticket and the prize have different responsibilities.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's in the box?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Something much easier to reveal after the conditions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've won the office parking space. I hold the allocation calendar.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I park there tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow's a premium day.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The prize said a free space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. We just haven't established when freedom applies.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember our relay signal? Two taps means I've got your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're running against each other today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll understand exactly when I'm helping.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please don't slow down for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: See? Thirty years, and we still know each other's tactics.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use our old quiz-night look when one of us knows the answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're on different teams.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That never stopped us knowing who needed help.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My team would call that cheating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They don't know our look well enough to judge it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I withdrew from last year's audition for you. I get first choice of songs now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to withdraw.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I made the sacrifice easy to receive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thanked you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks covered last year. This year I'm collecting the opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You had the good room on our last holiday. I'm choosing this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you liked the sofa bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I was generous in both room allocation and commentary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you say so?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I was saving the advantage for a holiday with a balcony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've moved my best chess piece so you can take it. Again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to let me win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. It's almost athletic how often I do it anyway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put it back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And waste the generosity I've already invested in this move?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've given you the easy half of the presentation. I'll explain the missing budget.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could split the difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then who would make you look so effortlessly prepared?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could prepare.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You say that like it wouldn't leave me with a vacant role.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You won yesterday's darts. That puts you ahead on treats, so you buy lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought winning meant I got the treat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It means you can afford generosity. Your confidence is funded.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if you win today?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lunch counts against the confidence you borrowed from yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You took the last deciding point, so I get first choice of film.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not in the tennis rules.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's in the balance of our friendship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If you dislike the film?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tomorrow's match will include compensation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't concede yet. I haven't got anyone else worth beating at chess.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've beaten me four times.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need a handicap, not a farewell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just take the trophy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And spend Tuesdays polishing it instead of annoying you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If you retire from the bake-off, who am I supposed to out-ice?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone younger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They haven't spent twenty years learning how to irritate me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could finally enjoy winning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd have to explain the achievement to strangers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we choose this year's holiday, settle who won the map argument in Cornwall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was fifteen years ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. We've given the evidence ample time to mature.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we just book somewhere?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After we establish who is allowed to navigate the website.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same board game, same disputed last move. I've kept the pieces exactly where they were.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've both moved house since then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The game hasn't. It's been waiting responsibly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather start again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Begin by retracting your objection to the old ending.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so casual collecting that prize. I'll collect mine without even standing fully up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't won one yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm preparing a more effortless response.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're practising it in a mirror.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only until it looks less prepared than yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How do you run five miles looking that relaxed? I'll do six smiling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm tired. I just don't talk while running.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll make my silence look energetic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're out of breath already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how much restraint my effortless performance requires.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring back the old quiz questions. I won three years running with those.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all remember the answers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it would reward loyalty as well as knowledge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just want to win again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want the quiz to rediscover its standards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This old sales chart shows what I'm capable of.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's from before we sold online.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's take the website down for a fair comparison.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Most customers use it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They never gave my telephone manner a chance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before announcing first place, could you say my name again with 'second'?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Second is a wonderful result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use my name in that sentence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Congratulations, Alex. You came second.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Keep looking this way while they fetch the bigger trophy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You put the winning photograph above mine. Can people still see mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is right beside the light switch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So everyone touches that wall. Good.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not a competition for attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nobody will mind if I stand beside it answering questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you teach the dog to fetch glasses, can I vote? I buy the glasses.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my training experiment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And my experiment is making rent after the breakages.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll clean up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Include replacing the glasses in your definition of clean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're inviting thirty people to camp in our garden? I maintain the lawn.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only one weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Grass experiences time differently. I want a say in tent placement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making this complicated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm trying to keep your simple weekend out of my next six Saturdays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've fixed your gate. Shall I come back next Sunday and do the gutter?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can visit without repairing anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll bring tools just in case conversation slows down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're already welcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. I'll make sure there's never a reason to reconsider.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep me in the quiz team. I've learned every capital we missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need to justify coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll learn the currencies as a bonus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We like your company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll make my company useful in two rounds instead of one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you announce my cake won, mention I iced it at three in the morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ribbon says first prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The ribbon got eight hours' sleep. It doesn't tell the full story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should I mention the ingredients too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only the ones I drove across town for after midnight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, we finished first. Please tell them whose weekend disappeared into that presentation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone worked hard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. My hard work includes a cancelled anniversary dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want that in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before the applause, while people still have room to appreciate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I won our coin toss. Please announce who sits by the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You do. Sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With my name. The other passengers weren't watching.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a train seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then a brief announcement will suit the occasion perfectly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before the next hand of cards, we need the winner's handshake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've won six hands.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And we've recognised only five. This is how records become unreliable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My hand is tired.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A nod will do if you make it ceremonial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the picnic sandwich carefully. There is no second lunch today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can share them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then neither of us commits. What does that make us?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Two people eating sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: History won't put that on a plaque.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If I send this birthday text with the wrong emoji, the friendship is over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can send another text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A correction? They'd know the first affection was defective.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a cake emoji.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Too many candles could accuse them of ageing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We lost the village quiz. Brilliant. Next week let's enter without a team name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How does that help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A nameless comeback. They'll have to describe us by our achievement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could study the questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And sacrifice the drama of learning under pressure?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My cake collapsed. Next year I'll make one with three tiers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You couldn't manage one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. One tier is now my origin story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if three collapse?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then four will have an extraordinary burden of redemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely trophy. Who pays to insure it while it's in my house?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's an honour to hold it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And an honour to replace it if the shelf collapses?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could donate it back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then what exactly have I won custody of?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So winning the best-garden prize means the public visits on Sunday?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's wonderful recognition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who opens the gate and cleans up afterwards?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The winner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I see. The second prize is a day off?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're not leaving until the scorer explains my missing half-point.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You lost by thirty points.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nobody needs to be frightened of correcting half a point.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It won't change the winner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It will change whether I lose accurately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My cake had one more cherry. That should settle the category.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The category was flavour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cherries have flavour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours was burnt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the surviving cherry deserves greater statistical weight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You offered to buy lunch. Clever way to choose the restaurant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was being friendly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A strong opening. Now I owe you both gratitude and the next lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can choose next time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Already planning a rematch. I respect that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The neighbour returned my ladder cleaned. That's a move in the gardening rivalry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Perhaps it was just dirty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Now my ladder is cleaner than my windows.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could say thanks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concede the first round? Not before I've polished his wheelbarrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The garden party is approved, subject to the usual considerations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Great. I've invited fifty people.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fifty is now one of the usual considerations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said it was approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I stand by the considerate part of that decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may borrow the car for a short trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only forty miles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Short refers to how long I'm willing to worry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't a distance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. My permission remains wonderfully adaptable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm chairing the club meeting until we locate the signed election result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have it. You lost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then may I respectfully propose we check both sides?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The back says the winner declined.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. My first decision is to store important documents face up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I hold the only key, so I decide when the rehearsal room opens.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine fits too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then perhaps you should choose today's schedule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's actually the cupboard key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You may schedule the cupboard. I'll handle the rehearsal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The engine is simple, apart from that red switch, which we'll leave alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to know what it does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, understand the twelve systems surrounding it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They all point to the switch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A useful opportunity to revise all twelve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain every clause in this lease except the one about renewal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's why I brought it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we should give it the benefit of a thorough introduction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It just says 'automatically.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A deceptively advanced word. Let's revisit 'lease' first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've moved the club's trophy cupboard. It used to be beside the piano.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've never had a piano.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You really are modernising everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This is the gardening club.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then retiring the piano made room for the original purpose. Sensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At our old reunions, Uncle Frank always carved the turkey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody here has an Uncle Frank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Families edit their history so quickly now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're at the wrong reunion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a remarkably efficient way to describe how much you've changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You spotted the deliberate error in my recipe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You baked it that way yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A demonstration is more memorable than a warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ate three slices.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Commitment to the lesson. I'm glad you're questioning authority now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've improved my filing system. Just the independence I hoped to provoke.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your system lost every invoice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And yours has found them. The learning journey is complete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did it by ignoring you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My most advanced outcome. I'll include it in the course description.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you explain why I shouldn't join the committee, shall I keep this envelope closed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's in it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me your reasons first. They sound carefully prepared.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only admit people who contribute to the building.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then perhaps now is the moment for my receipt for its new roof.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Go on explaining why you can't help me move. I'll save my little reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What reminder?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your reasons should have a fair chance without interference.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving is something people should arrange themselves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely principle. Shall we apply it to the piano I moved for you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember when you saved me the window seat? I thought I mattered to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I knew you liked the view.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Proof that you noticed small things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Also, the seat beside it had less legroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So my fondest memory of being understood was your knees negotiating space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You kept my first terrible painting. That used to feel wonderfully loyal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I still have it in the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you believed in me before anyone else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It makes visitors appreciate your later work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ah. My earliest humiliation has become your introduction to the house.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You fixed my bike, so I owe you dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was repaying the dinner you cooked last week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your repair was too good. I owe you for the surplus kindness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please don't cook again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're saving me work. The debt has increased.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I brought your parcel upstairs. We're even for the lift yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was addressed to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you've been storing it. I owe you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only noticed it just now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You saved me from thanking you excessively. Another favour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You fix the leaking tap this time. I'll stand here saying it'll flood.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It might. I can't find the valve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, give me the spanner. You're better at worrying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Actually, turning this stopped it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I'll return to wondering whether it'll start again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Today you reassure me about the presentation. I'm usually the calm one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. It'll be brilliant. Unless the projector fails.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the projector. You breathe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's working. See? Nothing to worry about.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let me worry about the audience while you stay impressively calm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cake won because it was minimalist. I'm removing half my decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yesterday you called mine bare.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before restraint became our competitive frontier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're copying me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Improving. I've now removed the cake stand too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your calm negotiating style is very effective. I'll speak even more quietly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You normally shout over me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An outdated phase of my restrained development.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't hear you now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I've achieved a level of composure you haven't reached.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my spare key. I trust you completely these days.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll just make a tiny adjustment to your shelves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give the key back. 'Tiny adjustment' preceded the last collapse.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't touch a shelf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The key is yours until 'improvement' enters the conversation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're in charge of my birthday. I know you'll keep it simple.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just a small surprise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That phrase cost me a weekend in a mascot suit last year.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No costume this time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you can keep planning. Slowly, and without using 'surprise' again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I still haven't forgiven you for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was outside. They wouldn't let me in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you were close enough to hear and still didn't call?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I heard you dedicate a song to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you knew exactly how abandoned I felt, in perfect acoustics.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I thought your apology was for forgetting my birthday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was for sending your present to the wrong address.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered, but somebody else got it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your old flat. I was trying to surprise you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now I have to forgive both disappointment and an extremely informed stranger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called my cake impressive. Now I'll need a second tier before you leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One tier was already impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Was. We've established that as the baseline.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to prove anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll add a third tier so that becomes convincingly true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said I handled the meeting well. I'll rewrite the whole agenda tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? You were excellent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent is now what they'll expect tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could take a break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: From a standard you've just raised twice?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My teenage self would hate me buying this sensible car.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It has excellent insurance rates.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly the sort of sentence he swore never to say.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then buy the motorbike.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Let him be disappointed somewhere with airbags.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I promised my younger self I'd never leave this town.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You also wanted to live on the moon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Some ambitions were symbolic. Loyalty wasn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So you're staying?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. I'm taking the photograph so he can disapprove from a better view.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The inspection passed? That's suspiciously convenient.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They found nothing wrong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the problem has become good at hiding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They checked everything twice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whatever escaped that deserves a more serious inspection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You say the neighbours liked my speech. What are they preparing me for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They just enjoyed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why tell you rather than me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They told you too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coordinated reassurance. That's what concerns me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me fix your bike before you ride. I know which bolts matter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've tightened them already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the checking. There must be something left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just come riding with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Without a repair to do? Give me a minute to remember how.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the difficult phone call for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made it. It went well.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There may be a follow-up only I can manage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather celebrate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could the celebration require help setting up? I'm better when useful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I bought the formal jacket you said would fit in at the club.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tonight's casual.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll become someone who wears a formal jacket casually.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can take it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not immediately. I've only just learned what kind of member this makes me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You wanted a more adventurous friend, so I've booked us climbing lessons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant trying a new cafe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Well, I'm a climbing person now. I've told my sister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cancel the lessons.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And become unreliable as well? I'm trying to keep one identity long enough to belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The roof practically fixed itself. My ladder was only there six weekends.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did a lot of work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing worth mentioning, beyond the invoices I've arranged by date.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are your initials on every page?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So the evidence doesn't embarrass us by becoming inaccurate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Anyone could have organised the concert. My thirty-seven calls were hardly heroic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thirty-seven?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only the completed ones. I wouldn't inflate the figure with attempts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want a thank-you speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, no. Just make sure whoever writes it has the call log.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we eat, tap your cup twice. Mum always did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: For good luck?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That was what she told guests. We knew it meant the tea was weak.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This tea is strong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today the taps can mean we wish she were here to complain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I always turn this chair toward the door before rehearsal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: To welcome whoever's late?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Originally. Then it reminded the late person everyone had noticed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody's late today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it can wait for the member we lost. Leave it facing outward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said that tiny crack in the stage was a warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now the piano's leaning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The crack has learned to accompany music.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to stop the concert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start by listening to the stage. It auditioned its objection this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The first wedding invitation came back misspelled. That was the warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now the cake names the wrong couple.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same mistake, larger icing budget.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The venue has two weddings booked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There it is. The typo has acquired a building.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, our outdoor concert is sold out!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's just been cancelled for rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, we've created an unforgettable sense of demand.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're refunding everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And demonstrated generosity at full capacity. Exactly the evening I hoped for.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've won the election! At last I can lead this club.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The recount says you lost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At last I can serve without the burden of office.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said office was the point.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, and now I've transcended the point. A more ambitious victory.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, the fountain grants wishes. Who pays its water bill?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It can wish the water free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then who pays the sewer charge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It has turned the pipes to gold.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Does the same meter now charge us for gold drainage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I accept that the house travels through time. The roof still leaks.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've arrived in ancient Rome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Ask whether someone here repairs tiles.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now we're at the moon landing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the original bucket under the original leak before it floats away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I gave you that key because you were welcome here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then why are you holding it like evidence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because the cupboard was locked before the cake disappeared.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I brought you a replacement cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then perhaps the key is a subscription. We'll discuss the terms over tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep this old ticket. It proves we went somewhere together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It proves you booked us different trains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it's evidence of a mistake we survived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I kept my ticket too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put them together. Now they're an invitation to get it right.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Make yourself at home. I've put fresh coffee on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought six suitcases.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Make yourself at home? I thought you meant a weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just until my flat is repaired.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Make yourself at home. I'll clear the drawer, but we're counting weekends together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Anything for you.' That's what I said when you asked for a lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now could we collect my piano?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Anything for you was much lighter five minutes ago.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the piano you learned on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Anything for you. But you're carrying the end with the memories.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That flat-pack cupboard's leaning. I could take a look.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got the instructions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Which page explains that leftover door?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold it for a second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Just to clarify: you're asking for my help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my jumper beside your broken heater.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not cold.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I'll put the spare blanket away too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Leave the blanket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shall I leave myself? I know where the fuse box is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you get your train, could you taste this soup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It needs salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix that. You'll need to check again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train leaves in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. That's when the bread comes out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've packed your suitcase upside down. Let me show you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A suitcase doesn't have an upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then explain these shoes facing the handle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. After we settle the shoes. It's a long journey.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've bought a replacement mug. Not that anyone needs to say anything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did I break your mug?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Interesting that you started there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry about the mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that tone. Think a little more recently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely day for clearing the air, isn't it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are we opening a window?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Some things require more than ventilation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have I upset you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's an excellent opening. I'd keep going.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you support a small improvement to the front garden?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What sort of improvement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Something with a pond. And no tree.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where's the tree?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's finish agreeing before the stump grinder leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How do you feel about me inviting a few people to dinner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tonight? We have two chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So standing guests would be more considerate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many people?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you answer before they ring again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You do such beautiful handwriting. Even your bin labels are elegant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thank you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Imagine what you could do with these eighty place cards.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking me to write them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wouldn't presume. I'm leaving room for your artistic impulse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've always said this shed could be organised better.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've cleared Saturday so I won't interrupt your vision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want me to clean it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if that still feels like your idea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bit with the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before or after it reached the balcony?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened on the balcony?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing confirmed. Who's been using that word?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That they're missing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No mention of a drain, then?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should there be?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm checking how thorough the briefing was.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need a lookout for a surprise dinner. Can you whistle?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who are we surprising?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum. She mustn't find the cake in the shed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not use the kitchen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because that's your second assignment. Distract her from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to the office at seven. Bring wrapping paper, not questions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Is this another secret leaving party?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need someone who can keep a straight face around balloons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is leaving?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Join the committee and you'll get a balloon with the name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That staff-only door might lead to the roof garden. Try it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone should stay here looking uninvolved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not allowed through either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll learn the rule together, with you slightly ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Taste a grape before buying them. Quality control.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sign says no tasting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Signs can't taste. You'll have better information.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taste one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need to compare your reaction with the official policy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you cut the ribbon, whose bridge is this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole town's.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And who stopped it leaning into the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. We thanked the engineers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Could one engineer have a name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've thanked the wedding guests. What about the person who cooked?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does the programme thank 'the buffet'?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll make an announcement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The buffet would like its surname pronounced correctly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already bought tickets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cake has your name on it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can visit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow it will have my name. Choose carefully.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take me on the expedition. I can read maps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So can the guide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can the guide remember your coffee order?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're crossing a desert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. You'll want someone who knows you take it iced.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which photo should go on the reunion poster? Mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sam's is sharper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Useful to know what clarity means to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You asked about the photo.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Nothing to do with who helped you move.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you keep Friday free? No particular reason.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even if something important came up here?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has something come up?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. I'm learning whether it would matter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me have the medal for the charity auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only thing I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it should raise more than the toaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I lend it for the display?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bidder will need more than a temporary victory.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the last word in this argument.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You're right.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Without that sigh.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't say anything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your sigh kept a spare last word. Hand that over too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've started investigating the broken vase. First, we check the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent clue. I'll inspect the glue cupboard personally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A piece of vase is stuck to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put me in charge of preserving it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office plant's dead. I'll interview everyone who watered it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You watered it with coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must investigate the coffee machine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made the coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Conveniently, I know exactly where to begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we discuss the dent in your car, I've found a lovely garage café.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you hit a bollard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their scones are enormous. Shall I book a table?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does the booking need a mechanic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent question. Let's inspect their staffing over tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't read that letter yet. Have you noticed the new curtains?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The letter says the rent's overdue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Think how much these curtains improve the room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How much did they cost?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at that bird outside. Perfectly framed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bakery loved your cake. They're just reorganising their menu.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The letter says 'inedible.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They mean it deserves preservation, not eating.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says the same about the icing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A very consistent compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your poem hasn't been rejected. The magazine's full.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's an online magazine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Storage fills up too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They published a new poem this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A short one. Yours needs a much bigger internet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me what you did to the printer, then I'll explain the kitchen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used the wrong paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How wrong? I'm calibrating my honesty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is the kitchen smoking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're still on your section. Did you apologise to the printer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's confess our mistakes. You first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I forgot the booking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's useful. How expensive a mistake do you consider that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What did you do?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm waiting for your estimate before choosing my opening adjective.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Removing the roof will make this restaurant wonderfully airy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happens when it rains?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Free table washing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The customers will get wet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An immersive dining experience. We can charge more.
