beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll need to approve your change of location.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may collect your coat once I've finished with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were only having coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And we're now concluding it formally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll dismiss the café first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology should mention interrupting the chair, not just spilling the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry about your trousers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The trousers hold no office.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry I interrupted you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Chair.' Let's repair the title while we're here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called my plan silly in front of the trainees.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry it didn't work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The plan failed privately. You disrespected me publicly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would you like an email?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With my position in the subject line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you endorse the new rota into this microphone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already said it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quietly. Quietly can't protect me at the staff meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I email you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy everyone who might blame me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign here to say you support the extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like it, but I'd rather not put my name down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your support has no address when objections arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I use initials?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if we print the key beside them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As junior coordinator, you get the blocked sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I coordinated the whole event yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And today we develop your drainage leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just don't want to do it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Senior staff must remain available to delegate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The inspection notes go down the chain to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're all the complaints.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll gain a broad understanding of operations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why do you keep the compliments?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They require a senior signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Everybody's approved the trip. Who can still cancel it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The committee signed unanimously.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whose phone call would make us tear that up?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer controls the deposit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Where's the treasurer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which signature actually releases this repair money?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All three are important.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which one could undo the other two?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance can freeze it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll take my broken pipe to finance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit on my side for the shed vote. It'll show broad support.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm undecided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sit broadly undecided beside me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That would look like agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. You understand the seating plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: May I put your name on the petition?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't read it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pencil, then. Provisional solidarity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's it about?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First let's get enough names for it to seem worth reading.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask the director why the overtime rule changed. I'll support you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your fresh perspective won't carry my disciplinary history.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you stand beside me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just behind. Where supportive people remain employable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You should question the queue-jumping policy at the club.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You hate it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which gives me excellent notes for your speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put your name on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold the notes. That's practically a signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce me as Director Patel, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Certainly, Pat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've removed the working part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a barbecue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then announce it over the sausages: Director Patel.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My place card should say Chairperson, not simply Jo.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nobody will struggle with the extra word.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no room on the card.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the larger plate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Are you backing my proposal or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like parts of both.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whose name goes above your favourite parts?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why choose a side?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because the meeting only has two sides of the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wear my campaign ribbon for the club election.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm staying neutral.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which campaign asked you to stay neutral?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Neither.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mine has an excellent vacancy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring that empty box to my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What do you need it for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At present, to establish whether you'll bring it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take it back without the question this time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stand beside the window while I check something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What are you checking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whether the instruction needs an explanation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's cold over here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then close the window and remain instructional.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hand me the hall key and tell everyone I'm now in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I just give you the key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The door will understand. The committee needs words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They know you're taking over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let them hear you stop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before leaving the meeting, name me as the person who decides.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're sitting in my chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Furniture announces location, not succession.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You're chairing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To the room, please. I already agree.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's fix the delivery mix-up. Send the crates back through my office.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your email sent them to the wrong city.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which means I know the route intimately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should we show the manager the email?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Show them my corrected routing chart first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody panic about the cancelled bookings. I'll direct the recovery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ordered the cancellations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then consistency demands I order the next step too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you cancel them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That question isn't recovering any bookings. Call this number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before questioning my appointment, finish the stock check.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who appointed you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stock first. Governance afterward.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I see the letter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can I see the stock? Only one is running out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My badge authorises this inspection. Open the cupboard.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no signature on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Signatures are tomorrow's administrative focus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you make the badge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're inspecting cupboards, not stationery.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The director's unavailable. Let's keep today's launch exactly as planned.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her office is empty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A distraction-free leadership environment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has she resigned?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The launch still has a time. Let's protect that certainty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've shortened the committee briefing so we can get through the fair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where's the treasurer's page?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It would complicate the cake stall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are we out of money?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We still have cakes. Let's discuss what can sell.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who supported your decision to close the workshop?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I signed it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who made it comfortable to sign?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director was consulted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Whose budget improves when the workshop disappears?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your proposal says 'we recommend.' Who's we?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The planning group.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which member would defend it if the roof falls in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance pushed for the cheaper option.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put finance beside the word recommend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've generously surrendered the chair's role.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You lost the election.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I gave democracy room to flourish.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're removing your nameplate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Space for my influence to become less obvious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've chosen to withdraw my exhibition proposal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The gallery rejected it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They correctly anticipated my next move.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They rejected the appeal too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A remarkably well-coordinated retreat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm cleared to inspect the storeroom. Here's my pass.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's unsigned.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approval has moved beyond handwriting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call the manager.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her the inspection's reached the telephone stage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've stamped my request. The room's booked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's your own stamp.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. A direct approval chain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can't authorise yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll need to discuss why the stamp says approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ranked our picnic contributions. Planning outranks sandwiches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also drove everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Transport comes below destination selection. Mine again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do we need a ranking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Questioning the ranking scores low on teamwork.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your suggestion is useful. I'll put it below my strategic overview.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My suggestion fixed the problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A practical achievement inside my strategic problem recognition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You caused the problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm foundational to the whole project.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've given me three more departments to cover. My influence is soaring.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've cut your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They trust me to transcend money.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've also lost your office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. My reach is no longer confined by walls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another complaint for me! I'm becoming central to everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're complaining about you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct public engagement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want you removed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A strong mandate to discuss my position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for choosing the venue. I've narrowed it to my garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I preferred the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A lovely contribution. We'll use its name for a garden table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So I don't choose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've helped us appreciate how much simpler this is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm so grateful you're helping. I've assigned your whole weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered an hour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Such generosity deserves room to grow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not available Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for clarifying. Saturday will be delightfully full.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll open the storeroom in return for a favour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need a mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it should be a modest favour. I'll name it later.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I borrow the key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a second level of membership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can introduce you to the curator if you support my exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Couldn't you just introduce us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. What a valuable ability.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What support do you need?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now we're near the gallery entrance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You nodded at Friday. I'll announce unanimous support for my plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to Friday, not the plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We've approved the timetable of my leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I object to the budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll announce unanimous calendar support first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You like the blue poster? Good, the campaign has consensus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I dislike the slogan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But its surroundings have your confidence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can't say I endorse it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll say you helped establish the visual direction under me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The kitchen supplies my team's tea. I need a kitchen key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You manage accounts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Accounts require alertness. Tea controls alertness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where does that end?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The roof leaks on the kettle. I'll need that key too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your delivery delays affect my schedule. I'll oversee transport.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You only book meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People travel to rooms. It's one system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you manage the roads next?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only the ones leading to my rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come help me paint the old kitchen. I want you there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could hire someone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They wouldn't know why we're keeping that pencil mark.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm terrible at painting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll be terrible beside the mark together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you come to my opening? Even for ten minutes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know anything about sculpture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You know me. That's the qualification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might say the wrong thing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say it in person. That's the bit I'm asking for.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishes are done. Before you go, are we actually okay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The kitchen's spotless.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking about the people who cleaned it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What else needs doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sentence that lets me put my coat on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call the taxi yet. We haven't settled last night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We finished the conversation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We stopped talking. That's a different task.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're going to make us late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd rather arrive late than leave like this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You apologised for missing my concert. What do you think the empty seat felt like?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train was cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know the timetable. I'm asking about the seat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You felt let down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Stay with that before explaining the train again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me you understand why six weeks of silence hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My phone broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For me, the silence didn't come with a repair notice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You thought I'd stopped caring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the bit I needed you to name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've accepted the new job. Are you glad?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need my permission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got the job. I'm missing your gladness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you be happy there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I think so. Could you try sounding hopeful with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We signed the lease. Say it's good news before I open the wine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've already decided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The contract's settled. Your blessing isn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I support you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now say it toward the bottle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take half these care-home forms. We shouldn't do this alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You understand them better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I understand enough to be tired.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Which half?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the page where I wrote your name beside mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hold the other handle of this box of old letters.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You packed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We filled it over ten years.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know what you want me to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carry your side while we decide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What should I write after your name on the wedding invitation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just write my name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's a box marked relationship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Leave it blank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will we sit beside the blank or at separate tables?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do I bring my own towel when I visit now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can use one here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The guest towel or the one that's always been mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever you like.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm trying to learn which choice I still have.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When Mum mentions the holiday argument, remind her I offered to drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: After you lost the tickets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can build toward that detail.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm telling the whole story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start at the helpful bit so the rest has context.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell Alex our promise meant alternating weekends.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember it differently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you remember my interpretation sympathetically?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the arrangement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stand beside me while I explain the improvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to the reunion with me. Let them ask what we are.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: People will talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's give one honest answer together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What answer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'we came together.' I'll stand beside you for the rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me one thing you usually edit out before sending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if it's awkward?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll know we're close enough for awkward.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll start, but promise not to send me a polished reply.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you box that photo, tell me that year mattered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only a picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say what isn't in the paper.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were happy there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now we can pack the picture without packing that away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call our trip a random weekend. We saved for months.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Name one thing before you throw out the ticket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed the boat and stayed anyway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. That's why this isn't just cardboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the work call ringing. Stay with this conversation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's important.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choosing us would mean something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call back in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Give these ten minutes to me without watching the phone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Skip the networking dinner. Have one ordinary evening here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This opportunity won't come again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Neither will tonight exactly like this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Couldn't we eat tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We could. I'm asking whether we ever come first today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which cup would you pour my tea into?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Either?

beats.text: What happens if it overflows?

beats.text: We'll borrow a saucer from Wednesday. Sign here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's nothing there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No visible defects. An excellent inspection result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do we stand on it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With confidence included in the materials budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You fold the moon; I'll stack these chairs.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why do you get chairs?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone must keep the achievable work moving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put yesterday's missing hour in this jar before lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Time doesn't fit in jars.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then loosen the lid. Don't make the opening smaller than necessary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You do it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm labelling. We mustn't confuse it with tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What keeps the soup inside that upside-down bowl?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've never seen it either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then turn the spoon over. Let's test which thing owns down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The soup followed the spoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Hold it over the sink while we learn the next rule.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shadow moved before you. What changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was walking slowly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop completely. Let's see whether it waits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's heading for the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then destination outranks speed. Follow without changing anything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The house is migrating. Help me choose where it should rest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Houses don't migrate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This one packed its chimney. We should support its journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where could it go?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Somewhere with good foundations and a watering hole.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Treat the kettle's complaints as advice. Help me answer it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only says boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A clear agenda. Ask what resources it needs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: More water?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We're already collaborating with the impossible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Catch one drop of tomorrow in this cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You do it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone needs to stay in today to record the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What counts as tomorrow's water?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me whether it tastes ahead of schedule.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Test the invisible bridge with your umbrella before I step on it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why my umbrella?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It reaches farther than your confidence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It went straight through.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good data. Try the next invisible plank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I drew that floating staircase last week. Mention the date.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can all see it now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I drew the handrail while you called it nonsense.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Well done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Loud enough for the people using my prediction to get upstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believed the cupboard before it learned to speak.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's asking for silence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One quick acknowledgment, then I'll respect its wishes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says you talk too much.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An informed opinion formed over years of my support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Are we shrinking or is the room growing? Choose before we move the sofa.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does it matter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One requires smaller movers, the other a larger van.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Stop ordering ordinary-sized biscuits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is gravity late, or are we early?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Neither makes sense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only one explains whether lunch should wait.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Gravity's late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the sandwiches somewhere they can land safely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If the ceiling's hungry, put its breakfast on the top shelf.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if it isn't hungry?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll have been polite. Lift the bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should I add a spoon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. That's a useful kind of belief.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reserve a chair for tomorrow's visitor as though they've already accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody's replied.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow works ahead. Leave one seat free.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What name goes on it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write reserved until time catches up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's an electrical fault.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the house can say so.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: House, would you like the light on?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Wait for an answer before reaching for the fuse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The keys aren't lost. They're invisible. Close your eyes and listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to see where I'm looking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the explanation I'm asking you to put down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hear jingling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Follow it without calling it coincidence yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's tether the floating cups before discussing this switch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You flipped it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A useful preliminary test. Now we know string is needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's labelled gravity off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Someone should label the string too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The summoned creature needs feeding. Forget the signature on the spell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's your handwriting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I can interpret its diet accurately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you summon it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's not ask origin questions while it eats the curtains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll ask why the ghost's here after finding out what it eats.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it here at all?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hungry, apparently. Expensive cereal or cheap?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ghosts shouldn't need breakfast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this one deserves a dietary consultation, not a debate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hold the bucket under the miracle leak.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How can water come from a painting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll discuss the frame once the carpet stops drowning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This is impossible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bucket doesn't require possibility to fill up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's prepare the chair for our visitor from tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says they can't arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A chair won't hurt while the calculation finishes being pessimistic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered the final number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we can see the next useful task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The model cloud produced one drop. Let's build the welcome tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That doesn't prove the full rain machine works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It proves the tray has a purpose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The forecast looks terrible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the small success where we can still see it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you notice the shadow reaching the door first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd rather hear your order of events.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, it moved before the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can admit I held the door for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did the soup wave at you too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are you staring at the bowl?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm waiting for an independent witness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It raised a noodle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I was beginning to feel rude not waving back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The map didn't find a door. Our real mission is waking this wall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So the map failed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At doors. Knock here; the wall looks asleep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not responding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're meant to listen through it. Put your ear down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The signal won't transmit. We were sent to receive, not send.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's only static.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the static's our message. Write the rhythm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's stopped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now we're learning silence. Keep recording.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Measure the cloud from its third elbow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Clouds don't have elbows.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not the first two. That's elementary cloud anatomy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where's the third?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Where your ruler becomes damp. There, you've found it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Turn the gravity dial politely, not clockwise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I turn politely?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pause at every number as though it might object.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It clicked at six.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Six has accepted your manners.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A flying chair needs a flying table. Where else will it eat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One flying chair is enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Enough for sitting. We're discussing hospitality.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then a flying table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And a hovering waiter. We can't keep making it land for soup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our invisible guest will need places for the entourage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only invited one guest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't expect them to leave invisible companions outside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many places?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set the room. We'll count the untouched plates afterward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The door opened into the broom cupboard. Wonderful, no travel time for cleanup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We wanted the garden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now we'll arrive with equipment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's opened into the attic next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can collect picnic blankets without stairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The clock's going backward. We're early for yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we can arrive before the invitation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We haven't got one yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look how efficiently time has solved the paperwork.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dragon's three heads are fine. Who left crumbs on my carpet?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're worried about crumbs?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three heads can manage one napkin.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's setting the table on fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then use a coaster. This is how furniture gets neglected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Floating furniture is manageable. That wet cup needs a mat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The table's approaching the ceiling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Taking a water ring to every altitude.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should we pull it down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only after removing the cup. Don't spread the damage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then return the ladder early.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I pay cash?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Money can't stand behind me in the sun.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll move forward. In my physics, standing still counts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't moved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only under your outdated definition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come toward me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're approaching my stillness. Excellent teamwork.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the lighter box, as agreed. This heavy one's now called light.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the weight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I changed the measurement. Much less effort.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It still weighs twenty kilos.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: New kilos. They're remarkably considerate to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If chairs float at noon, meetings need ceiling reservations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we stand?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then chairs get the ceiling without representation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're only furniture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With a daily migration. We'll need a chair ministry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bowl said hello. It must have a language and holidays.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only one word.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Possibly its national greeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What should we say back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask whether today requires a gift. We shouldn't start a diplomatic incident.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you co-sign the form for borrowing this barbecue?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help carry it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Sign under joint custodian before touching the handle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only a barbecue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then accepting half the responsibility should feel delightfully small.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put your name beside mine on the school-trip committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only offered to drive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Driving is a committee function now. Initial the route approval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You planned the route.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And your initials will make it a collaborative journey.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't leave the book club until we close the discussion together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodnight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I say 'chapter closed.' You say 'until next time.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you say both?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'd still be in a club with myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you hand in your shop keys, we do the farewell bell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because the bell rings constantly.

beats.text: Precisely. This is the last one you have to answer.

beats.text: Fine. Ring it.

beats.text: We ring it together. Leaving is still a team activity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Does that help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.text: There's no cake left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let the setting do some of the work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote 'sorry.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For all I know, that's about your choice of font.

beats.text: Fine. 'Sorry about the vase.'

beats.text: Excellent. Now send it to the people you blamed for it.

beats.text: You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch?

beats.text: I just said yes.

beats.text: And I changed my mind.

beats.text: Exactly. This year I'd like a dated yes to change from.

beats.text: Can I quote you saying my fence can stay?

beats.text: I suppose so.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which part may I quote? 'Can stay' or 'suppose'?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Don't make this official.

beats.text: That's precisely the unofficial answer I'm trying to prevent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name is beside bin duty on the rota.

beats.text: We swapped last week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last week's square is now safely in the past.

beats.text: You wrote this week's rota.

beats.text: And I admire how consistently it applies to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on becoming club president. Here are the toilet keys.

beats.text: Why?

beats.text: The president closes the building and cleans the toilets.

beats.text: I only accepted the honour.

beats.text: The mop is ceremonial until you put water in the bucket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the party report, what time did you arrive, leave, and visit the kitchen?

beats.text: Why specifically the kitchen?

beats.text: It's the only room missing from the timeline.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake disappeared then.

beats.text: We'll give the cake its own line. First, your kitchen time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm updating the car log. Mileage, fuel, and who had it after nine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why do you need the last name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every journey gets a name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never asked before the dent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dent has inspired better administration generally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern.

beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An excellent probationary performance. Here's your badge.

beats.text: How long is the appointment?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you find a qualified successor. The lantern must never be abandoned.

beats.text: Would you become honorary patron of our roof appeal?

beats.text: That sounds like a job.

beats.text: A job would pay. This comes with a very handsome ribbon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could my bicycle come inside the cafe just this once?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only because it's raining.

beats.text: Wonderful. I'll note rain as an accepted condition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This isn't a new policy.

beats.text: Of course. A precedent is much smaller.

beats.text: Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.text: Nobody's had an extension before.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we can discover whether it harms the form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One day. No more.

beats.text: Excellent. Next time we won't be discussing an untested idea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please put 'roof repaired by Pat' in the village minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all know you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The minutes weren't there with a ladder. They need telling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank you at the party.

beats.text: After the roof line, write 'thanks pending' so we remember.
