beats.text: There's a blank beneath 'cake design' on the prize certificate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You baked it. Everyone saw.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The certificate only names the club.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You are the club treasurer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I know precisely how to make that blank accountable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The handbook says lock at six. The festival permit says stay open. Which wins?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use common sense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which document authorises that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the front open and lock the back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then please choose which half of the building follows the handbook.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do we seat Grandma first or the birthday child? Both are family traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're both important.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's one chair at the head of the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Add another chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Shall I record furniture expansion as the governing tradition?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The family rule says 'save a portion for absent members.' How much will you save me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't specify a size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I'd like to see what you think membership is worth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone else is hungry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your portion will be a very honest interpretation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club says we support members 'where possible.' Will you support my appeal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's deliberately vague.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you get to give it a meaning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Other members might object.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Let's see whether 'possible' survives having company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Withdraw the complaint about your complaint number. We can process the original one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The original complaint was that nobody answered me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let's not distract them with a second opportunity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if they ignore it again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll have a beautifully consistent record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you stop demanding a private queue at the fete?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I donated the tent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then enjoy the ordinary queue in a setting you made possible.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I should get special treatment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You already have the best view of your contribution.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parcel encountered a breakdown between reception and dispatch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left it on the bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That was the transport interface.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were going home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. A regrettable overlap between staffing and distribution.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The birthday invitations failed during address verification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote our old address on every one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The archive supplied an outdated location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You are the archive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which suggests we've identified a staffing problem, not an individual error.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whether I broke the window is outside this repair meeting's scope.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let's hold a responsibility meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the repairs. We need a safe venue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can meet outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Location changes require a separate planning discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why I missed dinner belongs to the personal calendar review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're at dinner now. Review it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This is the replacement dinner, not the review dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: When's the review dinner?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Scheduling questions should go through the calendar process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the children the school trip has been postponed for repairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bus rolled into the pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And will require repairs. Keep the ducks out of the announcement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll ask when it's fixed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say we'll let them know when we have something cheerful to confirm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The official story is that Grandad's party has moved indoors because of weather.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He set the gazebo on fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There was certainly unexpected heat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shouldn't we mention him?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's let him blow out the cake before adding another fire to his record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the record, did you approve the fireworks before I discuss the invoice?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll reach purchases after authorisations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's a yes, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please keep your evidence separate from your interpretation of my evidence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me exactly who you invited before I show you the seating plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not show me first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I don't want the plan influencing your memory.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have you invited my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's finish your independent list before discussing mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cake collapsed, but every baking checklist was completed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's nothing to serve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There is a fully documented absence of cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The guests are waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we can demonstrate that no step was skipped on their behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our evacuation drill followed all seventeen instructions perfectly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're locked in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cupboard was the designated assembly point.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who designated it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That signature is on the completed checklist. Excellent traceability.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've completed the reciprocal invoice reconciliation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's just called paying the bill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. I was giving you the expanded terminology.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And you haven't paid it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're in the pre-payment reconciliation phase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I understand the club requires a quorum, so I've brought one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's a quantity of people, not an object.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. This is our quorum indicator.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a lemon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A provisional indicator, pending attendance confirmation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your picnic rota is nice. Mine has been ratified.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine actually tells us who brings sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Informally. Mine establishes sandwich jurisdiction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone's already brought food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my retrospectively ratified version will be invaluable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your bow at the ceremony was adequate. Mine follows the founder's original diagram.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The founder was sitting beside me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you obtain a written clarification?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He said 'stop bowing.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fascinating oral amendment. I shall request a signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've added a fourth inspection to our climbing wall. Wonderful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Opening is delayed another month.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A whole month without an uninspected climb.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll lose the season.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the safest season we've ever offered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The school trip needs a consent form for the consent form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Parents are refusing to fill it in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The first form is protecting informed choice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody can come.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we can confirm that nobody has come without consent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to the guest room. Please enjoy anything not labelled 'family.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bed is labelled family.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We want you to feel close to us without confusing ownership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where can I sleep?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The floor has no label. We like to keep something flexible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Delighted you've joined our swimming club. You may admire the pool until induction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: When can I get in?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After your supervised observation of another induction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The pool's empty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How lovely. You'll have an uninterrupted view.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I reassure you about the wedding, what precisely am I guaranteeing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That it'll be okay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Weather, marriage, or catering? They have different approval routes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just need a hug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One-time or renewable reassurance? I'll amend the request.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to lend you my umbrella. How long is the proposed loan?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Until this rain stops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An open-ended duration. Do you have a guarantor?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm getting soaked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Urgency noted. Please sign without dripping on the terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll clean the hall. The policy lets senior volunteers supervise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Supervising the mop is covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who will hold it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone whose contribution isn't restricted by seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I'll host Christmas, within our family's shared-effort rule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So what will you cook?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rule says hosting counts as effort.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does it mention cooking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not once hosting has been counted generously enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You spilled one cup. From now on, drinks need pouring permits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who issues those?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll appoint a pouring supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can't schedule a blink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll rehearse unscheduled blinking before each photograph.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That will take all afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We should appoint someone to monitor rehearsal duration.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lend me your good tennis racket. I'd like my talent to have a fair surface.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you admit it helped?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll thank the strings. The strokes remain mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can use your own racket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And let inferior equipment take credit for my defeat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can you tell me the winning cake temperature without becoming my co-baker?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want my secret recipe too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only the degree at which my original idea should happen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's most of the trick.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the temperature quietly so my achievement can concentrate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't leave the allotment until we've weighed both pumpkins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is clearly bigger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you won't mind witnessing how much bigger.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tell me tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow you'll say the scales were generous. Stay for the number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you go, read the final dinner bill with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can split it later.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First I'd like us both to see what 'just a starter' cost.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay my share.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Let's meet your share while it's still printed clearly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before congratulating the winner, apologise for starting me behind the shed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You still finished last.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I spent the first ten seconds finding the race.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was an honest mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely opening. Add 'and that was unfair to you.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you apologise for judging my cake after everyone knew it was mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You lost on flavour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You introduced it as 'another interesting attempt.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was being encouraging.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for encouraging the judges before they'd tasted it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say I earned the quiz trophy, not that the questions suited me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were a lot of bird questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I spent six months learning birds. That's preparation with feathers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were lucky they asked them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the birds were lucky I was ready. Now call it earned.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't think they let me win the race, do you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They slowed near the end.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because they couldn't maintain my pace.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One of them stopped to tie a shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then acknowledge my superior knot preparation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You lost the chess game. The agreement says you wash up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we were joking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You were very serious about my washing up while you were winning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we play again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the dishes. Call it a practical interval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you'd announce the budget cut if your plan cost more.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only cost slightly more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the announcement can be slightly apologetic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could explain it better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. But the bargain gave you this development opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you call the picnic a success, what are you measuring?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone having fun.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And how do I rank against last year's organiser?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not a contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does your clipboard have last year's sandwich total?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What do you gain if your cousin wins the club election?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A competent president.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And which of your proposals becomes easier to approve?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The car park needs resurfacing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I know which square of competence we're discussing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put on our quiz-team badge before I explain the final round.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? What happens if we lose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll face that together. That's what the badge means.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to face anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's start with the very easy agreement to wear blue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Back my stall at the fete. Sign here above 'joint entrant.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's the penalty clause below it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The sort of challenge best discussed between partners.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not your partner yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly why I've left a convenient space for your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's make this chess game decide who cooks all weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were playing for a biscuit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Neither of us has been emotionally changed by the biscuit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't need chess to change me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll enjoy discovering how much the kitchen matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you put your club captaincy on the rematch?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's a ridiculous risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We'll both remember the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Isn't pride enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've misplaced the results of six games played for pride.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you thank the festival team, mention who repaired the stage in the rain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll thank everyone equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Which equal sentence includes my waterproof trousers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want your name in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the part that kept the dancers above ground.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It helped enormously.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With what?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keeping track of the bookings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Add 'all thirty missing bookings' and I'll recognise the achievement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we celebrate afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can keep the prize money or fund the team trip. Which matters more?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we do a cheaper trip?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if someone adds money. You hold the prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making me look selfish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking you to choose before everyone else quietly pays for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you give me your first turn, even if it costs you the match?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I do that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you were on my side. This side has a cost.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant emotionally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lend the emotion a turn so I can see it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Miss the prize ceremony and come to my tiny opening night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm receiving the prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. Coming wouldn't mean much if you had nothing else to do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an unfair test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Maybe. I'm trying to discover whether I'm more than the convenient option.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concede that one ball was out. You can keep the match.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then why does it matter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like one corner of reality returned to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not demanding a rematch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Just say 'out' without attaching your trophy to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Admit I found the restaurant. You can keep credit for the whole holiday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You also complained about the menu.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Different claim. I'm not filing it today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You found it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. The rest of your glorious itinerary remains untouched.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fair result. Let's celebrate my cake's first prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you move yours under the judging light?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lighting maintenance. We shouldn't let logistics overshadow flavour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine was left in the shade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A useful note for whoever organises next year's logistics.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our raffle draw was impeccably random.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You folded your ticket differently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A filing convenience. I'm speaking as chair of results now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can feel which ticket is yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's avoid testing theories after such a clear result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's discuss our quiz preparation, not the final score.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did we come last?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We identified the greatest number of learning opportunities.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many points did we get?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, appreciate how bravely we attempted the geography round.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The race taught us a lot about pacing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stopped halfway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A natural point for reviewing the first half.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everybody else finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And missed a valuable opportunity to reassess their strategy mid-course.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You beat me at chess. Take a photograph of the board.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you use your queen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted to explore the rest of my team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you go easy on me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You found the finishing move. Let the photograph remember that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on winning the cake contest, Mum.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your cake isn't on the judging table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It stayed in the kitchen where I can admire it privately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You withdrew so I'd win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still beat seven cakes that had every intention of winning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I tell you who won, which candidate were you hoping for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You look disappointed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ignore my face. It isn't your ballot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tell me your choice first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'd never know whether your kindness voted with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which job offer did you secretly want me to accept?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever makes you happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you knew which one made me happy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does it matter now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because I haven't told you what I chose, and this is our last unbiased minute.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Losing the entry fee bought us a complete map of the competition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We entered to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A short-term interpretation of the investment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't afford another entry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the information has become exclusive. We'll use it selectively.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Selling the stall at a loss freed us for a much bigger opportunity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Which opportunity?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We now know precisely which business not to buy again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an expensive lesson.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We couldn't have learned it at this depth for free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know this board game. I'm opening with the horse in the lake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't horses. That's the scoring marker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I'm testing the scoring environment first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not allowed to move it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We have established a stable scoring environment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've calculated the optimal move in this raffle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You buy a ticket. That's all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The timing of purchase is crucial.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The tickets are shuffled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely the variable I was waiting for you to confirm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our cakes tied. Next round, blindfolded icing. Loser cleans the kitchen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A tie is a perfectly good result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it should survive a more informative test.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want another cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can compete over who persuades the other to bake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We split the bill exactly. Now toss for who apologises to the waiter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why should anyone lose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise this dinner ends without a distinction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We both enjoyed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then least enthusiastic enjoyment pays the tip. Rate yours carefully.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six losses! Our comeback will need its own documentary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The tournament is over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the documentary opens next season.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our team is disbanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A reunion comeback. You've just improved the second act.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My collapsed cake will make the next one look magnificent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've burned the oven out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll begin the comeback with a new oven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The competition's tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An overnight oven installation. Now we have genuine suspense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on the prize. Such a lovely year for forgiving judges.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you saying I didn't deserve it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm saying they saw past things I couldn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't much of a compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then admire how hard I'm working to make it one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful promotion. Your timing with the director's retirement was beautiful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I worked for this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And how considerate of the vacancy to arrive when you were ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you just be happy?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm choosing the most generous version available this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lend you the ladder if helping earns me first choice of barbecue food.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't it just be a favour?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. What does the favour redeem for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Friendship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Is friendship available before the sausages run out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If I apologise first, what do I win?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: An end to this argument.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And if your apology follows, do we split the victory?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not a game.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why is going first carrying all the risk?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fair race gives me a head start. I've had a tiring morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So has everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then compensate us proportionally. Mine involved stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We start on the same line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Move my portion of the line forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll agree to equal cake portions if mine accounts for the baking time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's a bigger portion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only before labour is included in the calculation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ate the spare icing already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Research and development. Please keep the categories separate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our table-tennis rematch decides who cleans up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. One game.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And whose cleaning method we use all year.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not what I agreed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's ask the whole club to witness the clarification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the biscuits carefully. The winning plate goes to the neighbourhood meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's just a snack.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's also our first impression of the new committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They won't care.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put your name beside the plate so we can test that publicly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carry the table with me, not for me. I'd like us to be partners today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger. I can do it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the arrangement I'm trying to stop calling our friendship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Take the other end.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Now ask where we're putting it instead of deciding for both ends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me write the complaint as a colleague, not my parent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only correcting your spelling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave the angry sentence. That's my contribution.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quite a good sentence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put both our names under it, not 'on behalf of.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's cold now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I wasn't really waiting for the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What were you waiting for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A goodbye that doesn't sound like you're already somewhere else. Have another sip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't go yet. You came to return the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I thought putting it down would take longer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need it back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I needed to see whether you'd sit down before giving it up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for apologising for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So we're okay?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Closer. Now why did I have to ask whether you'd noticed missing it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for letting me rehearse your apology alone all week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I accept your apology for breaking the vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The vase was cheap. You let me blame the dog for three days.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was embarrassed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the dog and me which part of that embarrassment we deserved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: May I put one extra chair in the hall?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. It's for the chair of my new tenants' committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I approved furniture, not a committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then welcome to our first agenda item: what your chair authorises.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can a couple of relatives come for tea?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, that's fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. They're bringing the cousins who introduced them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many people is this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It starts with the approved couple. The rest is family context.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you'd take it from here. Here are the unanswered wedding invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd answer the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. These people need an answer before reaching it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not the same job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me explain where your generous offer ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember volunteering to finish the last detail of the fete?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The banner, yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The banner announces a raffle nobody has organised.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered to paint words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And 'raffle' is the word still needing the most work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whose coat needed the second cup of tea while I was out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coats don't drink tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: True. Who was keeping that one warm from the inside?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're asking who visited.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still on the cup. Did its owner take sugar?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did the kitchen light go off after the extra dinner plate was used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask who came over?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to understand the timetable first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We ate late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then which bus carried the timetable's missing person home?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you help me tidy the committee cupboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sure. Where do we start?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With the records proving we should replace the committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to tidy, not overthrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm asking again, now you can see what we've been storing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Join my campaign to save the club garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Absolutely. Who threatens it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our extension plan. The one we both signed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're campaigning against ourselves?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We know the opposition's weaknesses. Will you join the honest version?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pay the climbing-course deposit before we discuss the cliff.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to climb.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's refundable only if we attend the first lesson.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So paying makes not climbing harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A small commitment can do the worrying for us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the committee we're considering the festival bid. Just the announcement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We haven't decided to bid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Once they've reserved the date, we'll have something worth protecting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That sounds like deciding backwards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I prefer starting with the consequence that encourages us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember my suggestion to put the spare key under the flowerpot?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I called it unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now we're locked out beside a very useful flowerpot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Good idea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say whose idea while you lift it. The pot can't accept all the credit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That strip of tape I added is holding the whole stage curtain up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought it looked untidy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Untidiness has just saved the finale.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank the stage crew.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the person you asked to remove the tape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the overseas job or our shared shop. Then we'll know what 'we'll build something' meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. This choice gives the old sentence its ending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job sound like a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking whether your promise has room for the shop without you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant a quiet evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keeping it can mean the evening ended.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And returning it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make that evening the beginning of something neither of us named.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign up for the overnight shift if this project matters to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have you signed up?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm keeping myself available for leadership decisions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: At three in the morning?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Apparently my test has reached a less comfortable definition of commitment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give up your prize seat to prove you're on my side.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you give up yours too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine is essential for maintaining perspective.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You mean watching comfortably.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I may have designed a test I wasn't planning to take.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can I keep one plant on your windowsill?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One small plant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Sunlight is available to guests. Shall we discuss the other pot?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you've agreed the principle. Now we're negotiating the size of its audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Admit that I helped with one paragraph of the speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The opening paragraph, yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The paragraph that establishes the argument for the rest?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Don't claim the whole speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only following the opening wherever you took it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember the decorative ribbon? That's where the whole tent problem began.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tied it to the support rope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, but nobody questioned why the ribbon was there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you pulled the rope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Following the ribbon's invitation. We should review decorative influences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That innocent cup started the argument.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tipped it onto my letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A badly positioned cup creates difficult choices.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was in your hand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which shows how far the cup had already entered the situation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it rained all evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked why you crashed my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And before that you asked whether the roads were wet. They were.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you driving too fast?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast said showers. I should answer that original question completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked if lunch was good. The soup was excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, but slightly salty. I hadn't finished my lunch review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forget lunch. Answer about the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You also asked where we ate. That deserves a precise answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wedding venue has made a small change.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What changed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened to the building?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your garden gnome is coming home in a different arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What arrangement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Several pieces, carefully packed. I wanted you to hear 'coming home' first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Is it broken?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Most pieces are here, and we can start with the smile.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I changed the meeting time. Did you change the room?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the time?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. That's my half of why nobody met.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you tell me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I should have. Now tell me where your half of the meeting went.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I hid the first complaint letter. What happened to the second?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've admitted hiding a letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I'm not asking you to stand in the spotlight alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There was a third one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's put our envelopes down in order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The collapsed cake was foreshadowed by that first wobble.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ignored the wobble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I allowed the audience to discover its significance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There is no cake now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The empty stand pays off the warning beautifully.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The tent falling is our planned turning point. Remember the loose peg I mentioned?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were supposed to fix it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nobody would understand why it mattered later.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're standing in the rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the earlier remark about waterproof coats has become remarkably well placed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I said the evening would flow, I meant this kitchen flood.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You meant conversation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Water is now the dominant topic. A remarkably accurate forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said we'd need to open up. The plumbing listened first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My forecast said sunny. Clearly I meant your reaction to the refund.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The holiday was ruined by rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which created the refund and your brightened outlook.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote 'pack sunscreen.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A symbol of optimism. You must read the whole prediction generously.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last in the race, first in appreciating the route. Beat that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a speed contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A narrow category. How many wildflowers did you notice?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I noticed the finish line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I also win for variety of attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The small trophy is better. It shows restraint.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the consolation prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. How gracefully can your enormous cup fit in a cupboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine says first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And mine doesn't need to shout. Another victory in modesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The roof needs replacing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It may cost our savings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We said the concert would bring the village together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The power's out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll sing together without microphones.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half the audience has gone home for torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at that. The village is already supplying its own light.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my good teacup. It'll remind you of our afternoons wherever you end up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I end up elsewhere?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone as capable as you must have wonderful doors waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking me to leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm making sure you won't mistake this doorway for your last opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed extra sandwiches for your journey. You always forget to eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm only visiting the next town.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they'll keep you well as long as you choose to stay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That sounds very final.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only because I want the last thing you hear here to be kindness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift costs petrol and a proper conversation about why you stopped calling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay for petrol.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. That gets the car moving, not us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we discuss it another day?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today costs petrol and another postponed conversation. The second price is rising.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow the dress for ten pounds and an acknowledgment that you mocked it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's twenty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Money covers fabric. It doesn't cover wearing my bad taste proudly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. It's beautiful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now say which part of my judgement improved since yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said I'd carry one box. That warehouse isn't the box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help me move.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With one box. We admired how manageable the sentence was.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Make it the biggest one, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. The word 'one' has retained its dignity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I agreed to watch your dog today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow's only a few hours away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A separate word with no place in our agreement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you loved dogs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An enduring feeling, not a calendar extension.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said 'nothing can go wrong' before balancing the key on the teacup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It fell into the cup. I dried it with the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now the invitation has dissolved around the key to the wedding hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can still prise it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Your 'nothing' has become both the lock and the address we can't read.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember calling the spare chair unnecessary before giving its place to the cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake needed somewhere flat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the guest sat on the piano stool, and you moved the pianist to the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's managed perfectly well.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until we open that window to cool the cake. Every sensible decision is now sitting on the next one.
